why_not: I'd like the magnesium, but I've never heard of this brand and nobody has reviewed it yet. Paying £19.99 now for something that won't ship until January, when Boots and Holland & Barrett will have their own deals on magnesium, is not how I shop.

Magnesium sounds sensible but I have never bought it and a brand with no reviews is asking me to pay now for something that ships in January. I would want to see whether anyone has actually felt a difference before I hand over money.

£19.99 plus £4.99 delivery for gummies I've never tried is too much when the energy bills are up. Sweets for children don't feel like a serious supplement to me, and I'd rather spend on tablets I already know.

I'd pay £19.99 plus £4.99 delivery for a brand I've never heard of, with no reviews, when Boots magnesium is about £5 and I wait for their 3-for-2. I'd have to pay today for a jar that doesn't ship until January, and I'm not doing that.

I take my vitamins from Boots and restock when they run out, and I'm not paying nearly twenty quid to chew sweets with sugar and glucose syrup in them when I'm already worried about my sugar. It's a brand I've never heard of and there are no reviews yet.

I like the idea of magnesium for sleep and stress, but I see gummies with sugar and glucose syrup and I think, that is not what I want to put into my body every day. I would have to see a real reason to trust it before I spend money on a brand I have never heard of.
